title: Prevalence and Clinical Significance of Co-infection of Mycoplasma Pneumoniae in Patients With Pulmonary Tuberculosis
brief_summary: Several case report showed that the co-infection of Mycoplasma pneumoniae in patients with pulmonary tuberculosis. The aim of this study is to elucidate the prevalence and its clinical significance of co-infection of Mycoplasma pneumonia in patients with newly diagnosed pulmonary tuberculosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bacteriologically or clinically diagnosed pulmonary TB
* Older than 17years

Exclusion Criteria:

* HIV positive
* Immune-compromized
